Anatomy Ballistics — Swift Playgrounds (iPad, FREE)

This is a finished playable app for Apple Swift Playgrounds.

INSTALL (iPad)
1. Install free “Swift Playgrounds” from the App Store (Apple).
2. Download AnatomyBallistics.swiftpm.zip and unzip it.
3. In the Files app you should see a folder/package:
      AnatomyBallistics.swiftpm
4. Tap it → Open in Swift Playgrounds
   (or Share → Swift Playgrounds).
5. Tap Run / the play triangle if needed.
6. Tap TAP TO PLAY → drag aim → tap FIRE.

ALSO FREE (no Swift Playgrounds)
Open browser/AnatomyBallistics/OPEN_IN_SAFARI.html in Safari.

CONTROLS
- Drag     aim (red reticle)
- FIRE     shoot .22 LR (3s cooldown)
- NEXT     closer stage / wall
- RESET    rebuild body, back to 40 ft

STAGES
1–6: 40 → 15 ft
7: house wall (drywall + wood, −270 fps)
